note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; the substitution states no legal effect.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: The lens enlarges the account-reference field of a fictional intake record; inside the lens its value goes from visible to covered by a band; the context then shows the same change with a marker.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: the extent of an existing band is substituted — the phone value goes from fully covered to partly covered, so its last digits become readable; a different record and a lens placed above the field.

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Long field label, long before/after values, long context caption and marker label.
